reason: The README describes an index and distribution channel that browses, packages, installs, and composes DeepSeek Harness plugins into runnable Agent profiles, making orchestration the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 用于浏览和分发 DeepSeek Harness 插件及 Agent 配置，并通过 xlings 安装插件、组合 Agent 配置和注册运行命令。
summaries.en: An index and distribution channel for browsing and installing DeepSeek Harness plugins and Agent profiles, composing packages, and registering runnable commands through xlings.

capabilities: browses and indexes DeepSeek Harness plugins and agent profiles
downloads and installs pinned packages through xlings
composes plugin manifests into agent profiles
registers executable command aliases for installed agents
